value.title: Episode 1
value.synopsis: Nozomu is ready to open up the new Rainy Color branch... in Waikiki!

value.title: Episode 2
value.synopsis: While cleaning up the new cafe location, Nozomu finds a ghost.

value.title: Episode 3
value.synopsis: Nozomu and his new helper Shank try Hawaiian-grown chocolate and find a new shop dog, Shine.

value.title: Episode 4
value.synopsis: After ordering too much product for the cafe, Nozomu needs a little help...

value.title: Episode 5
value.synopsis: Nozomu and Shank go looking for showpiece items for the store.

value.title: Episode 6
value.synopsis: Nozomu gets a little more help in the form of Nikola, Noel, and Haruka.

value.title: Episode 7
value.synopsis: The kids try developing new recipes for the cafe, but Shine isn't making things easy.

value.title: Episode 8
value.synopsis: It's Halloween in Hawaii! Can the kids get Nozomu to dress up for the occasion?

value.title: Episode 9
value.synopsis: The cafe's decorations are finished, but Nozomu still thinks something is missing...

value.title: Episode 10
value.synopsis: Nozomu and Shank end up in a terrible fight over advertising for the cafe.

value.title: Episode 11
value.synopsis: Still in need of a showpiece product, Nozomu resorts to desperate measures.

value.title: Episode 12
value.synopsis: Waikiki Rainy Color opens on Christmas Day!
